records.subject: Thermally regenerative electrochemically cycled flow battery (TREC-FB)
records.object: Continuous power output, heat source/sink decoupling, heat recuperation and stacking compatibility
records.quote: Compared with other electrochemical devices such as the temperature-variation based thermally regenerative electrochemical cycle and temperature-difference based thermogalvanic cells, the thermally regenerative electrochemically cycled flow battery (TREC-FB) has the advantages of providing a continuous power output, decoupling the heat source and heat sink, and recuperating heat, and compatible with stacking for scaling up.
records.conditions: Compared with temperature-variation-based TREC and temperature-difference-based thermogalvanic cells.

records.subject: Difficulty matching catholyte and anolyte pH with desirable temperature coefficients
records.quote: However, the TREC-FB suffers from the issue of stable operation due to the challenge of pH matching between catholyte and anolyte solutions with desirable temperature coefficients.

records.subject: pH-neutral KI/KI3 catholyte–K3Fe(CN)6/K4Fe(CN)6 anolyte TREC-FB
records.object: Cell temperature coefficient of 1.9 mV K−1
records.quote: In this work, we demonstrate a pH-neutral TREC-FB based on KI/KI3 and K3Fe(CN)(6)/K4Fe(CN)(6) as the catholyte and anolyte, respectively, with a cell temperature coefficient of 1.9 mV K-1 and a power density of 9 mu W cm(-2).
